mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT INNER_LIST.*, ROWNUM AS RNUM FROM ( SELECT R.*, M.MNAME FROM RATING R LEFT JOIN MEMBER M ON R.MNO = M.MNO ORDER BY R.RNO DESC ) INNER_LIST ) WHERE RNUM BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow}

SELECT m.mno, m.mname, od.odno, od.bno, b.bname, b.bimg, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rating WHERE odno = od.odno AND bno = od.bno AND mno = m.mno) AS cnt FROM member m JOIN order_list ol ON m.mno = ol.mno JOIN order_detail od ON ol.olno = od.olno LEFT JOIN book b ON od.bno = b.bno WHERE m.mno = #{mno} AND od.bno IS NOT NULL ORDER BY od.odno DESC
select r.*, m.mname from rating r left join member m on r.mno = m.mno order by r.rno desc
select r.*, m.mname, m.memail, b.bname, b.bimg, b.bprice from rating r left join member m on r.mno = m.mno left join book b on r.bno = b.bno where r.rno = #{rno}
mapper.insert: insert into rating(rno, rrate, rtitle, rcontent, rfiles, rdate, rhit, mno, bno, odno) values(RATING_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{rrate}, #{rtitle}, #{rcontent}, #{rfiles, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, 0, #{mno}, #{bno}, #{odno})
